title: Libre 1, MiaoMiao 2 and SSW3 why won't it work away from phone!
symptom: The user has a SSW3 watch and can display readings from the phone, but when the watch is out of range of the phone, it no longer gets readings. The watch is connected to the MiaoMiao (shows 'Wear' battery) but readings do not update and go to strikethrough after about 10 minutes.
evidence_quote: I got my hands on a SSW 3 and although I can get it to easily display what is on my phone as soon as the watch is out of range it no longer gets readings.
